occasion: A smoke test of the lines acted out in Blender (blender/collapse.py): the house of 23 falls in on itself, the one yang line coming down on top, under a Blade Runner searchlight; the user asked for it on 2026-09-26. The series short is left alone.

meaning.text:
Stay and help
those below you.

caption.text: The mountain sits on eroding earth, and the old text tells those on top to give to those below. The summit rests on the base.

lesson.text:
Falling apart?
Shore up the base.
lesson.source: series/characters.json#23: A knife stands beside a block; pieces fall off the block one by one until only its base stands; then both lie down as the character.
